title: BRIEF-Pro: Universal Context Compression with Short-to-Long Synthesis for Fast and Accurate Multi-Hop Reasoning
selection_reason: BRIEF-Pro is a universal lightweight context compressor that distills retrieved documents into query-focused summaries at up to 32x compression, directly reducing RAG reader latency and context cost across model sizes.
venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
